place.name: Favara, Sicily
place.description: Favara (Italian: [faˈvaːra], Sicilian: [faˈvaːɾa]) is a town and comune (municipality) of south central Sicily, Italy, in the province of Agrigento, 8 kilometres (5 mi) north-east of Agrigento by road, with which it forms a conurbation. Historically, the town has had a considerable agricultural trade, and there are sulfur and other mines in the neighborhood.
